title: Puharich's upstate New York camp channeling the Nine
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Puharich's upstate New York camp channeling the Nine, about 1950s-1970s at Upstate New York, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: telepathic state. And he everybody he had this camp in in upstate New York, and all these quote unquote space kids would go up there and channel what he called the nine, these alien beings. And he was a contractor for the CIA.
had an experience, he would hypnotize them. And allegedly, the nine would come through even through these kids,
